subject: Kickoff: Project Nimbus (BBF productization)
body:
Team,

Kicking off Project Nimbus, our push to take the BBF agent from research code to a supported sample-efficient RL offering. The pitch to leadership: human-level Atari at human-level efficiency, which translates directly into customer environments where interaction data is expensive.

Scope for this window (Mar 2 - Jun 1): harden the JAX implementation we open-sourced (it builds on Dopamine), keep SPR and SR-SPR runnable as hyperparameter configurations for baseline comparisons, and stand up a reproducible eval sweep on the Atari 100k benchmark. Milestones: M1 repro of published results by Apr 3, M2 config/API cleanup by May 1, M3 internal demo for the Launch Review Board by May 27.

Ivo owns staffing; Wei is tech lead. Freya, please own the SR-SPR replay-ratio configs since that is closest to your prior work.

Thanks,
Ulla
